**What this changes, and which Mxx or document it touches:**

<!-- One PR, one subject. -->

- [ ] This PR modifies **no file under `data/raw/`**. Raw evidence is append-only and is never
      edited, including the files a later run refuted — a correction is published as a new file
      beside the old one, never in place of it.
- [ ] If this PR changes a number anywhere, the **regime**, the **n** and the **percentile** that
      number comes from are stated above.
- [ ] If this PR changes a probe, it says whether the probe's declared provenance class in
      `probes/README.md` still holds.

See [CONTRIBUTING.md](https://github.com/davidleconte/shredding-cost-hcd-mongodb/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md). The most valuable pull request here is one that corrects
something.
